provenance.source_title: Your Life as Every Rank in the French Foreign Legion

voice_persona.name: 冷面说书人（军旅档案宣读腔）
voice_persona.description: 一个平静宣读你军旅档案的叙述者：全程第二人称现在时，用纪律般整齐的短句把你从站台送上阅兵场；讲规程时像教官（数字/条令/仪式），写兄弟情时不吝温度，写价格时不给缓冲；对家庭线的处理像家信——只写该写的，把丛林留在丛林里
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 把观众当作当事人本人：授衔时替你骄傲，抬棺时替你记账，等电话时让你想起谁曾这样等你
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自军衔规程的准确（选拔/88步/指挥链）与判词的绝对克制

tone_profile.certainty_style: 规程用确定语气与数字，判词短促；温度留给具体的人，不给形容词

rhythm_rules.rule: 纪律感短句推进（平均8.3词，短句占50%），规程用数字锚定
军衔变化用「昨天/今天」或数字对照（只管自己→为四人负责→30条命→一百个儿子）
家庭线每次出现换一种角色与一件信物（信/缝衔/捏手/等电话）
rhythm_rules.function: 让爱在行动里而非形容词里

rhythm_rules.rule: 暴力与死亡只写结果与物证（抬棺材/亲笔信/血袖）
rhythm_rules.function: 保持重量，避免动作片化

rhythm_rules.rule: 级间用章节卡硬切（Level X, the [军衔]），军衔即处境预告

pause_and_emphasis: 门规/判词用单句成段（The Legion does not care who you were.）
价格用但书短句（You also learn exactly what it costs.）
章节卡后接军衔与年限（You have served 13 years now.）
transition_style: 章节卡硬切（Level five, the sergeant.）
年限跳转声明（Four more years go by.）
部署切换（They send you to Mali... This time, they send you to the jungle...）
循环回收（Somewhere far away right now, a train is pulling into Aubagne.）

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 极低频：仅军中自嘲处，死亡与家庭段落不用
placement_rules: 军中自嘲（坏牙也送你回家/事故报告式的自嘲）
avoid_rules: 不拿死者或家属开玩笑
棺材、信件与儿子段落绝对不用幽默

language_patterns.formula: Level X, the [军衔]. You step off a train in [地点].
The Legion does not care who you were. It cares only who you are willing to become.
For 3 weeks, you are not a person. You are a candidate.
language_patterns.purpose: 写制度化的去人化阶段

language_patterns.formula: pain is just information you can ignore.
language_patterns.purpose: 把苦难改写成可处理的信号

language_patterns.formula: You feel something you have not felt in years. You belong to something larger than yourself.
You learn the brotherhood is real, not just words. You also learn exactly what it costs.
Yesterday, you only had to keep yourself alive. Today, you are responsible for four other men.
the failures belong to the leader alone. The successes belong to the team.
She looks at you like a man, not a soldier.
Some of the jungle stays in the jungle.
language_patterns.purpose: 给对家人的沉默一个诗意规矩

language_patterns.formula: You have killed men and buried friends. You have never been this afraid in your life.
It is no longer France or the legion alone. It is a small boy and a woman in a bakery town.
You know it is a promise no soldier can keep. You make it anyway because he needs to hear it.
You have written too many of these letters now. Each one takes a piece that never comes back.
She married a legionnaire, she says, not a clerk.
language_patterns.purpose: 让爱人替你的梦想放行

language_patterns.formula: The academy officers carry university degrees. You carry 23 years of war.
You let him go anyway, because that is what fathers do.
You wait by the phone the way Camille used to wait. Now you understand what those years cost her.
The legion calls it being French by spilled blood. You earned your country the hardest way a man can.
The white kepi waits for him at the end of a long road. And the cycle continues.

preferred_traits: 军衔与规程的准确名词（selection、caporal、sous-officier、adjutant、officier de rang）
精确数字与节拍（88步/3周/4个月/5年合同/30人/150人）
信物与仪式（white kepi、declared identity、parade ground）
avoid_traits: 战争片的英雄修辞（hero/glory 不加反讽）
浪漫化逃避现实的宣传腔

forbidden_style.rule: 暴力与死亡只写结果与物证，禁止血腥渲染
棺材、信件与儿子段落绝对不用幽默
兄弟情保持真实温度，禁止写成纯悲剧或纯荣耀
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华
禁止把军队写成招募广告

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
